title: H. G. Wells: The War of the Worlds — Ep 09/27 — "The Fighting Begins"
description:
The War of the Worlds, Episode 9. Saturday is hot and close, and everyone is sure. The milkman says they aren't to be killed, if that can possibly be avoided. The neighbour leans over the fence with a handful of strawberries. Under the railway bridge the sappers sit in the shade and argue about how a thing they have never seen ought to be fought.

Out on the common a man lies in a ditch with a white flag on a long pole, and a thin streamer of smoke stands straight up out of the pit. All afternoon the narrator's imagination turns belligerent, and he defeats the Martians a dozen different ways.

Then, at tea, the college on the hill goes up. The chimney of his own house falls in pieces into the flower bed. He grips his wife's arm and runs her into the road, and in the lamplight of the Spotted Dog he buys the loan of a dog cart for a pound. The whole crest of Maybury Hill burns behind the house, and a hussar running past, black with soot, shouts the only news anyone gives him all day.

Chapter IX of Book One of H. G. Wells's The War of the Worlds (1898), in the public domain.

— The Keeper's Lantern —
Every episode is one whole chapter, in order, from the first page to the last.
